description: Obligation of Federal Funds by Functional Class and Improvement Type, 2023-2024 (FA6A) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. Obligation of Federal funds administered by the Federal Highway Administration by functional class and improvement type both on and off the National Highway System as reported in the Highway Statistics table FA6A. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 6 columns, among them Improvement Type, Outlays, NHS, Fclass, Year, Area. The portal shows 2026-02-06 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
